Found 9 items in registries @amplo:

Showing items 1-9 of 9:

- color-picker (registry:ui) - OKLCH-native, Display-P3-aware color picker built on Base UI primitives — Hue/Lightness/Alpha on Slider, FormatSwitcher on Select, ChannelInput on NumberField, Swatches on RadioGroup. Pulls the shared OKLCH engine and pointer-driven parts (Area, Chroma, GamutBadge, ContrastReadout, Preview, EyeDropper, CssInput) as a registry dependency. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gradient-picker (registry:ui) - Linear / radial / conic gradient editing on Base UI primitives — TypeSwitcher/InterpSwitcher/RadialSizeSelect on Select, ReverseStops and the StopList editor as semantic buttons, and a StopEditor composed from this variant's own Hue/Alpha/FormatSwitcher/ChannelInput. Pulls the color picker plus the shared gradient engine (Bar, Area, Overlay, pads, Presets, CssInput, stop popover shell) as registry dependencies. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- fill-picker (registry:ui) - Color + gradient + the solid/gradient mode switcher (FillPicker.Root/Tabs/Tab/Pane) — the "give me everything" entry point, Base UI variant. Pulls the Base UI color and gradient pickers plus the shared fill switcher parts as registry dependencies. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- color-picker-radix (registry:ui) - Radix/shadcn-classic shells for the Amplo color picker — Hue, Lightness, Alpha, FormatSwitcher, ChannelInput, Swatches, GamutBadge and ContrastReadout built on shadcn's Select and Tooltip. The OKLCH engine, contexts and pointer-driven parts come from the shared color engine, pulled in as a registry dependency. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gradient-picker-radix (registry:ui) - Radix/shadcn-classic shells for the Amplo gradient picker — TypeSwitcher, InterpSwitcher and RadialSizeSelect on shadcn's Select, plus the popover stop editor. Gradient parsing, contexts and the pointer-driven parts (Bar, Overlay, Area, StopList, angle/position pads, Presets) come from the shared gradient engine, pulled in as a registry dependency. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- fill-picker-radix (registry:ui) - Radix/shadcn-classic entry point for the Amplo fill picker — the barrel that composes the Radix color and gradient pickers with the shared solid/gradient mode switcher (FillPicker.Root/Tabs/Tab/Pane), pulled in as registry dependencies. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- color-picker-engine (registry:ui) - Dialect-agnostic core of the Amplo color picker: the OKLCH state engine (types, conversions, gamut math, CSS Color 4 chroma reduction, WCAG + APCA contrast), the React context, and the pointer/canvas-driven parts both variants share — Root, Area, Chroma, Preview, EyeDropper, CssInput, Field, and the tooltip-agnostic GamutBadge/ContrastReadout logic. Installed automatically as a dependency of `color-picker` (Base UI) and `color-picker-radix`; you do not normally add it directly. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gradient-picker-engine (registry:ui) - Dialect-agnostic core of the Amplo gradient picker: CSS gradient parsing/serialization with per-stop format state, the gradient context and hook, and the pointer-driven parts both variants share — Bar (with its stop-editor slot), Overlay, Area, StopList, StopColor, angle/position pads and inputs, ShapeSwitcher, ReverseStops, RepeatingToggle, Presets, CssInput, and the anchor-only stop popover shell. Installed automatically as a dependency of `gradient-picker` (Base UI) and `gradient-picker-radix`; you do not normally add it directly. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- fill-picker-engine (registry:ui) - Dialect-agnostic core of the Amplo fill picker: the solid/gradient mode state (fill context + `useFillPicker`) and the FillPicker.Root/Tabs/Tab/Pane parts both variants share. Installed automatically as a dependency of `fill-picker` (Base UI) and `fill-picker-radix`; you do not normally add it directly. [@amplo] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
